hero.tagline: An organisation committed to healthcare and educational support.
hero.headline: Healthcare, Education and hope for those society too often leaves behind.
intro: Amaan Ansari Welfare Foundation is a state-level registered public welfare organization in Chhattisgarh, dedicated to working continuously in the fields of healthcare, education, and social welfare. The organization aims to provide essential support to underprivileged and economically weaker sections of society and to promote awareness about health and education. The head office of the organization is located in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh.

vision.title: Founder's Vision
paragraphs: When Amaan  was alive, I would regularly help a poor, needy, or underprivileged person with the intention of giving charity on his behalf. About a month before his passing, I brought home a small earthen money bank. From that day onward, sometimes with Amaan 's blessed hands and sometimes by myself, I continued putting ₹10, ₹20, or ₹50 into that money bank with the intention of charity. In my heart, I had planned that once the money bank was full, it would be given to someone in need. But Allah had something else destined. On September 7, 2021, my beloved son Amaan  passed away. It was the greatest test of my life.

Two days after his passing, on September 9, 2021, his Chehlum was observed. After Fatiha, Quran recitation, and prayers, food was served to the poor and needy. When everyone had left, my wife pointed toward that earthen money bank and said that it should also be given to someone in need.

At that very moment, a thought struck my heart like lightning. I thought, "Just as I knocked on every door and made every possible effort for my son's treatment and his life, if I devote that same passion, that same restlessness, and that same determination to serving Allah's creation, perhaps my heart will find peace, Allah will be pleased with me, and this service may become a means of my forgiveness."

I immediately wrote "Amaan Ansari Foundation" on that earthen money bank and gave the first money bank to a poor child named Ali to support his education. This was the first step from which the foundation of Amaan Ansari Foundation was laid.

After that, I brought 40 more earthen money banks. Each money bank was marked with the name "Amaan Ansari Foundation" along with a separate number. I then gave these money banks to people and requested them to contribute according to their means, either daily or whenever possible, so that the collected amount could later be used to help the poor, orphans, patients, students, or anyone else in need.

This small earthen money bank gradually became a movement. Today, if Amaan Ansari Foundation is playing its role in serving society, its true foundation was not built upon a large institution, great wealth, or a grand building. It was built upon a small earthen money bank, a father's pain, a son's memory, and the sincere intention of seeking the pleasure of Allah.

Alhamdulillah, even today, I believe that the reward of every good deed, every smile, every act of help, and every prayer should first reach the soul of my late son Amaan . May Allah make this service a means of my forgiveness, salvation, and success in the Hereafter.
With time, the scope of Amaan Ansari Foundation's services continued to grow. What began as a small earthen money bank has now grown into a formally registered organization working to serve society.

At present, our organization is functioning as a state-level registered institution. The organization was registered on February 6, 2026, under the name "Amaan Ansari Welfare Foundation," and was reorganized on February 18, 2026.

Today, the organization is continuously working to expand its services in the fields of healthcare, education, and other areas of public welfare. The objective of the organization is to provide assistance, as far as possible, to the poor, needy, helpless, and disadvantaged sections of society, while making a positive and lasting contribution to the fields of healthcare and education.

The organization is committed to working in accordance with its registered rules and regulations and defined objectives, while expanding its activities into various areas related to public welfare in the future.

We believe that the true identity of any organization is not defined by its name or registration, but by its selfless service to society, honest efforts, and noble intentions. With this belief, Amaan Ansari Welfare Foundation continues to move forward on its journey of service.
A journey that began with a single earthen money bank has now transformed into a commitment to serving society.

labels.founderBio:
Alim Ansari is a 39-year-old businessman and social worker, born on 12 May 1987 in a small village in Muzaffarpur district, Bihar. Despite difficult financial circumstances, he completed his early education at a government school in his village. In 1995, at around seven years of age, he came to Bilaspur with his elder brother. Due to his excellent academic performance, he was admitted directly to Class 5 at a private school.

Considering his family's circumstances and his elder brother's struggles, he discontinued his education after high school and began supporting the family business. After marriage, he became the father of two daughters and a son, Amaan . When Amaan  was diagnosed with a serious blood-related illness, Aleem Ansari made every possible effort to ensure his treatment for nearly two and a half years. Despite his continuous efforts, Amaan  could not be saved.

This profound personal loss changed the direction of his life. Inspired by his family, friends, and doctors, he resolved to serve society with the same dedication and determination with which he had fought for his son's treatment. Since then, he has remained actively involved in the fields of healthcare, education, and public welfare.

Aleem Ansari believes that “Life is a test, and true success lies in the good deeds we do.” Alongside his business, he dedicates a significant portion of his daily time to social service. His compassion, spirit of service, and consistent efforts have become an inspiration to many people.

Today, Aleem Ansari has established himself as a respected social worker. He has been honored for his social contributions in various cities across the state and is frequently invited as a chief guest at numerous social and public events. His purpose is clear—to dedicate his life to helping those in need and contributing to the welfare of society.

whoWasAmaan.title: Who was Amaan? (emotional story)
paragraphs: Amaan Ansari was the third child of Alim Ansari, born after two daughters.
At around 6 months of age, he was diagnosed with a serious illness called Aplastic Anaemia.

He was receiving treatment at CMC Hospital Vellore in Tamil Nadu. During this period, when Amaan was about 2 years old, the country was under lockdown. Despite transportation challenges, his father travelled a long distance by car to continue his treatment.

Doctors explained that the only permanent cure was a bone marrow transplant, which required both a suitable donor and financial support. After many efforts, a donor was found, and preparations for treatment began at Narayana Hospital, Bangalore.

However, about five days before leaving for Bangalore, on 30 October 2021, a tragic incident occurred. Late at night, Amaan’s health suddenly deteriorated. He was rushed to Apollo Hospital, Bilaspur, where doctors found internal bleeding leading to a stroke; he slipped into a coma.

Despite continuous efforts and medical consultations, there was little improvement. On the seventh day, a slight movement gave hope, and doctors advised shifting him via air ambulance—but sadly, later that evening, Amaan passed away.

inspiration.title: From inspiration to service
paragraphs: Amaan’s struggle and memories continue to live on.
Transforming this pain into strength, Amaan Ansari Welfare Foundation was established, and today it stands as a ray of hope for the needy.

projectGullak.title: Project Gullak – a unique initiative
projectGullak.intro: “Project Gullak” is a unique and inspiring initiative by the foundation.
origin: It began from an emotional habit where Amaan’s father used to save small daily amounts in a clay money bank (Gullak) as charity—to help someone in need in the future.
After Amaan’s passing, on 9 September 2021, that same Gullak was donated in the name of the foundation to a needy child named Ali for his education. This marked the beginning of the project.
Over the last four years, hundreds of Gullaks have been distributed under this initiative.
workingModelItems: The foundation provides special multi-use Gullaks to individuals.
Each Gullak includes a serial number, contact details, and project information.
People voluntarily save money and can use it to help someone nearby, while informing the organisation.
projectGullak.participation: This initiative has been promoted on major platforms in Bilaspur, receiving strong community participation.
projectGullak.goal: “To help at least one needy person every day through Project Gullak.”
projectGullak.message: “Small savings can fulfill someone’s big dreams.”
